bsi.editorial_reason: Remove an inherited key/alias that incorrectly attributes a distinct generic, geographical or personal lexical reference to this narrowly defined source identity.
editorial_evidence: Clear-Bible Macula WLC@47db250bd55d0d8577f2a94fba114ef16c35b23c and Greek SBLGNT@8423afe47b9e8f24b7772e808af45c7159a6fe7e, complete original-verse inspection in #136 CI

Genesis 15:10 names birds generically (צִפּוֹר); Ecclesiastes 12:4 also has generic צִפּוֹר, not a Hebrew sparrow species. The generic Bird entity owns actual birds in those verses; the species Sparrow must not own the contextual generic keys.
